a quiet babbling stream winding through the undergrowth
soft mist drifting low through the scene
a mirror-still pool reflecting the canopy above
a misty waterfall threading down a mossy wall
a fallen mossy log bridging the way
shafts of golden light breaking through the canopy
a clear spring bubbling up among the ferns
dew sparkling on every leaf in the soft light
drifting petals and leaves carried on a gentle breeze
a soft earthen path winding deeper in
a mossy old stone bridge arching over a brook
an ivy-covered ruin half-reclaimed by the green
